dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The module describes the global production mix for jointly produced zinc- and lead-concentrates from sulphidic deposits. The multioutput-process “exploitation, zinc-lead-deposit” delivers the three co-products “lead, concentrate, at beneficiation” and “zinc, concentrate, at beneficiation”. It is designed for the use of the concentrates as raw material for the ultimate production of lead and zinc.; UUID: 4b7c911d-f95a-3d99-a16c-389eaf259c0d

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
This module is approximated with values from nickel-mining. Mining is assumed to be underground, followed by froth beneficiation. Overburden and tailings are disposed inside the mining panels. For electricity mix a mix of 25% coal and 75% gas fired plants was chosen.

# Included processes
The module includes the mining and the beneficiation step with the mining infrastructure and disposal of overburden and tailings (see part "Auxiliary Processes").
